snippet.title: Eventide Matter - Gameplay Trailer 1
snippet.description:
▶ Release date on Steam: 5 Nov, 2025
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455780/Eventide_Matter/

▶ Eventide Matter is a 2D space mining adventure. Pursued by relentless enemies, you must mine exotic resources and use them to upgrade your equipment and build a massive inter-dimensional portal to get back home.

▶ Visit my website for more information:
https://www.ottropi.com/
